description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2940014352609 FILTER ELEMENT,INTA: Line 0001 Qty 122 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0162 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
